params.prompt: The character in <Picture 1> sneaks forward in a deep crouch, walking slowly and carefully in a continuous, looping crouch-walk cycle, seen in strict side view (profile), facing left. Knees deeply bent the whole time, body kept low (about a third lower than standing), torso leaning forward, arms bent and held low in front. The camera tracks alongside like a treadmill shot so the character stays centered; the full body from the top of the hood to the feet is always in frame and the feet are always visible. Each slow step: a blade foot reaches forward and plants on the ground, the strongly compressed backward-bending hock takes the weight, then the rear foot lifts and swings forward low over the ground. The character never stands up. Keep exactly the same character design: chainmail mesh hood over a pale face, dark rust-stained armoured torso, black box backpack, wide boxy rust-orange armoured thigh plates down to the knee, and DIGITIGRADE mechanical legs: thin dark shins that slant backward from the knee to a raised hock, and feet made of three long curved blade tines forming a backward hook whose tips touch the ground. Plain neutral grey seamless studio background, even soft studio lighting, realistic 3D render, no other objects, no text.
